⚔️ Easton stared down the Hushpuppy and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Silas stood down the Anaconda Empress and kept walking — 5 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Nino killed the Heckler alone — 4 rounds, 34 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
You keep a day's food (1040 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 20 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
